_meta._note: Chapter 18 final test (ch18-test, new). Twelve multiple-choice questions on the proposal's blueprint: follow الَّذِي back to الْوَسْوَاسِ (2), sound definite/indefinite construction (3), adjective versus description (2), الَّتِي in Al-Mujadilah 58:1 (1), described noun and main statement (2), Quran fragment meaning and Quran versus authored (2). No memorising all six ayat, present-verb paradigm, plurals/duals, case analysis or the morphology of يُوَسْوِسُ / تُجَادِلُكَ. Pass mark 80 % (10 of 12). Rebuilt 2026-09-23 from Docs/proposals/chapter-18-content-proposal.md; the chapter map and fixtures named three different source files (reader_lecture_18_relative_pronouns.md, reader_lecture_book2_lesson7.md, tadabbur_an_nas.md), none of which existed in the repository, so the approved proposal is recorded as the source.

noor_explanation.en: الَّذِي began this chapter in An-Nas, describing the whisperer of 114:4. You can now read descriptions with الَّذِي and الَّتِي, choose them correctly, and tell them from adjectives and from full sentences.
noor_explanation.ur: الَّذِي سے یہ باب سورۃ الناس میں شروع ہوا، 114:4 کے وسوسہ ڈالنے والے کی وضاحت کرتے ہوئے۔ اب آپ الَّذِي اور الَّتِي والی وضاحتیں پڑھ سکتے ہیں، انہیں درست چن سکتے ہیں، اور انہیں صفات اور مکمل جملوں سے الگ کر سکتے ہیں۔
